summary: Iridium Communications Inc. filed an 8-K announcing entry into a definitive merger agreement with Rocket Lab Corporation on June 28, 2026. Under the agreement, Iridium shareholders will receive $27.00 per share in cash plus a variable number of Rocket Lab common shares, subject to an exchange ratio based on Rocket Lab's stock price. The transaction is structured as a two-step merger intended to qualify as a tax-free reorganization. Iridium's board unanimously approved the deal and recommends stockholders adopt the agreement. Advisors were not named in the excerpt. The closing is subject to Iridium stockholder approval, regulatory clearance, and other customary conditions, with no specified timeline. Watch for shareholder vote and regulatory review.
